name: trackiq-amazon-amc-ntb-campaigns
title: TrackIQ: Amazon AMC New-to-Brand Campaign Scorecard
summary: Ranks every campaign Amazon Marketing Cloud can see — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and DSP — by how many of its purchases came from new-to-brand customers, month over month, and where the campaign's spend can be matched, what each new customer cost; so the campaigns that recruit are funded and the ones that only harvest repeat buyers are named.
changelog: Pulls spend for the prior month too, so the cost-per-new-customer trend can be computed, flags only recruiters on it, and shows a dash rather than a cost for harvesters.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
